meetingFlow.title: Meeting
meetingFlow.about: Record a meeting on this device. The transcript, summary, tasks and decisions are made here, and nothing is sent anywhere.
meetingFlow.checking: Checking which models are on this device…
meetingFlow.unavailable: Unavailable: no transcription model is on this device. Download the Hebrew dictation model or a Whisper model under Settings → Models, then open this again. Nothing was recorded.
meetingFlow.name: Meeting name
meetingFlow.liveOff: No live transcript: the recording is transcribed on this device after it stops.
meetingFlow.speakersOn: Speakers are identified on this device.
meetingFlow.speakersOff: Speakers are not identified: no diarization model is set up on this device.
meetingFlow.summarizing: Writing the summary, tasks and decisions…
meetingFlow.saving: The note comes from the transcript, so it is saved only after you approve it…
meetingFlow.declined: Not saved: you declined. The note is below, to copy.
meetingFlow.failed: The meeting note could not be made: {error}
meetingFlow.empty: Nothing was heard in the recording.
meetingFlow.note.summaryChecked: Checked summary: every sentence is copied from the transcript (a local model picked them).
meetingFlow.note.summaryExtractive: Extractive summary: the most central sentences (no local model, or its summary did not pass the check).
meetingFlow.note.noModel: No local model was available to find these.
meetingFlow.note.rejected: {n} items the model wrote had no source in the transcript and were left out.
